pd_new_teacher_mentoring_001.evidence: Teacher Mentors are selected teachers in Minneapolis Public Schools who have agreed to serve for up to five years within a position/category as mentor teachers... District Mentors work primarily with probationary teachers in the Achievement of Tenure process at multiple sites. They provide support through facilitating New Teacher PSP meetings, coaching, co-teaching and observing teachers.
